name: basic
grammar: grammar Removed { token T = REGEX('[a-z]+') @root Root ::= T; }

name: v1
grammar: grammar Removed { @ubnf: v1  token T = REGEX('(?s).') @root Root ::= T; }

name: v2
grammar: grammar Removed { @ubnf: v2  token T = REGEX('\d+') @root Root ::= T; }

name: unicode-crlf
grammar:
grammar Removed { // 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
 token T = REGEX('[unterminated') @root Root ::= T; }

name: short-class
grammar: grammar Removed { token T = RegexTokenParser @root Root ::= T; }

name: qualified-class
grammar: grammar Removed { token T = org.unlaxer.dsl.runtime.RegexTokenParser @root Root ::= T; }

name: keyword-with-whitespace
grammar: grammar Removed { token T = REGEX   ('a') @root Root ::= T; }
